candidate.verification: The source version surfaces identify 2.12.2, and its local runtime, browser and test evidence is scoped in TEST_REPORT.md. The GitHub source release is published; it is not durable-host or deployment proof.

visual_proof.state: The published 2.12.2 source defines 240 reviewed concepts and 240 exact semantic scenes.
visual_proof.interactive_browser_qa: The privacy-reviewed README selection was captured from the locally served 2.12.2 source and is recorded in assets/readme/proof/2.12.2/manifest.json. On 2026-08-27, the formal three-viewport Playwright matrix passed 35 tests with 40 intentional project-scoped skips and zero failures against the FastAPI-served production bundle with CSP; the 240-scene catalog rendered at thumbnail, card and hero sizes in each project. Generated contact-sheet inspection, human recognition, provider verification and deployment remain separate gates.

oauth.boundary: Historical 2.4.0 production evidence verified identity-only Google sign-in, reload continuity, logout and signed-out persistence on 2026-07-21. It does not prove current hosted availability, a live GitHub session, re-login after logout, provider connector calls, two-real-user isolation or backup restoration.
